outcome: Ledger entries record their currency and are totalled per currency.

acceptance_criteria.text: Entries are totalled separately per currency.
The schema change can be deployed while the previous release is still writing entries.

expected_verification.assertion: the migration applies and the old code can still insert entries until the new release is live

data_impact: Adds and backfills a column on the largest table in the schema.
rollout: Migration and application release are separate deploys.
rollback: Dropping the column loses currencies written after the migration.
